newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trading firms seen under pressure - Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Japan trading firms seen under pressure - Moody's.

text.p: Moody's Investor Service said on Tuesday that earnings of Japanese general trading companies were expected to remain under great pressure due to fierce competition and erosion of franchise value.
The current rating outlooks for the five largest companies reflected the potential for selective rating downgrades, Moody's said in a statement.
It said the five were Itochu Corp, Marubeni Corp, Mitsubishi Corp, Mitsui & Co Ltd and Sumitomo Corp.
"They (the five firms) demonstrate high tolerance for diversification investments and the parent companies' earnings continue to suffer from investment failures," Moody's said.
Currently, Itochu is rated A3, Marubeni A3, Mitsubishi A1, Mitsui A1 and Sumitomo A2.
